crossRefs.note: and let the maiden who pleases the king be queen instead of Vashti.” The thing pleased the king, and he did so.

people.name: Memucan
people.line: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media.

translations.web: This advice pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Memucan:
translations.bsb: The king and his princes were pleased with this counsel; so the king did as Memucan advised.
